title: Additivity of low degree evaluation
statement: For all nonnegative integers $n$ and $\ell$, evaluation of a sum of two coefficient families on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$, using monomials of degree at most $\ell$, equals the sum of their evaluations at every input.
hypotheses_covered: two coefficient families indexed by subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$
